recomputed.method: Independent re-derivation from raw files (Airbnb_Open_Data.csv['review rate number'], indoors.csv['rating'], outdoors.csv['rate'], tx_clean.csv['Rating']); clip to [1,5]; per-source robust Z = (x - median)/(1.4826*MAD); 95% CI = mean +/- t(0.975,n-1)*std/sqrt(n); one-way ANOVA via scipy.stats.f_oneway with SS-based eta^2.

notes: p-value display artifact: anova_detail.json/execute_summary.json report log10(p) ~= -692.06 (p_display '~1e-693') from a chi-squared limit approximation; an independent converged log-space quadrature of the exact F tail (validated against scipy.stats.f.sf on cases that do not underflow) gives log10(p) ~= -685.26, i.e. p ~ 1e-685. The gap (about 7 orders of magnitude, both astronomically small) concerns only that intermediate display value; output2.csv correctly stores the float64 result 0.0 and the significance decision is unchanged.

Interpretation caveat: each source is robust-Z-scored against its OWN median/MAD, so the reported means measure how far a domain's typical value sits from its own median (in robust SD units), not absolute satisfaction. On the raw 1-5 scale the ranking is different (outdoor 4.67 > indoor 4.38 > destination 4.16 > accommodation 3.28) and eta^2 rises to 0.1269 (verified: F=7791.61).
Effect size is small: eta^2=0.0195 (Cohen's benchmarks: 0.01 small / 0.06 medium); with N=160,802 the ANOVA is statistically decisive but only ~1.9% of variance in robust-Z scores is between domains.

Independence caveat: FISETIO rows are venue-month aggregates (27 museums, 83 parks) with repeated monthly ratings, i.e. pseudo-replication; variance heterogeneity is severe (Levene on raw values = 4764.64, p~0, reproduced), so the equal-variance F test is approximate. Upstream venue-level sensitivity check (robust-Z with venue means replacing venue-month rows: F=127.97, eta^2=0.0025) was reproduced exactly, confirming the between-domain signal survives but is modest.
raw_scale_anova (F=7791.61, eta^2=0.1269) and all 6 pairwise Welch t-tests in posthoc.json were independently reproduced.
No out-of-range values in any source (all within 1-5), so harmonization required no rescaling/winsorizing; valid_n matches data_profile.json exactly for all four sources.
bottom_line: Both deliverables exist, are schema-valid, complete (4 sources / 1 ANOVA row), and every reported statistic reproduces to within 1e-6 of an independent recomputation from the raw data. Domains differ significantly (F=1064.89, df=(3,160798), p<1e-300, eta^2=0.0195) with a small effect size; accommodation (+0.19) and destination (+0.11) sit above their own medians while outdoor (-0.19) and indoor (-0.65) sit below.
